<vbox

            hidefor="imap,nntp,ews,graph"

              prefstring="mail.server.%serverkey%.download_on_biff"
            />
          </vbox>
          <!-- POP3 -->
          <vbox
            id="pop3.settings.box"
            align="start"
            hidefor="imap,nntp,ews,graph"
